market.title: Bonds Traders Look to Hedge Risk of Fed Rate Cuts in 2027
market.summary: Bond traders are looking to hedge the risk that the Federal Reserve pivots to cutting rates in 2027. Bloomberg's Ven Ram has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
